draw.method: eligible = candidate likely groups sorted by id, not _oem_held(cat, nissan); quotas by largest remainder (ties by cat name); per cat in sorted order rng.sample(ids, quota); pairs: rng.sample(remaining sorted ids, 30), then per group rng.choice(seeker vehicle-year), rng.choice(other vehicle-years) for donor

notes: RULES I apply (fixed before reading most items):
- missing own list page for a vy: if the product record's list_url is that vy's page (list_info = its row) and a same-chassis page shows siblings, treat as seen; else RISK.

- option groups: note "option: fits some option packages" absorbs siblings distinguished only by trim/option codes and the unexplained '*' mark, UNLESS the sibling distinction is a drive/engine/cab/body/trans word (then check gate) or the '*' decides a drive split.
- window: plausible MY Y build span 06/(Y-1)..09/Y. A same-option sibling whose production boundary falls inside that span on an ungated vy => RISK (window edge). Built gate present => fine.
